name: shared-templates
description: The shared Zavon number's templates a workflow's Send a WhatsApp step may name (core: workflow.SharedTemplates and notify.Catalogue). The organisation's name is always the first variable and core fills it; the step gives `params` for the rest. The words are Meta's to keep once approved: a change is a new name.
